column1: # Format alias map  (design §4). Vocabulary + aliases taken verbatim from ComicRack CE:
# and Formats/map.ini. Rendered as our own glyph + label, not CE's rasters.
#   aliases     pipe-separated extra spellings (canonical matched too, case-insensitive)
#   symbol      FluentIcons.Common.Symbol name; blank = letter-mark only
#   label       short chip text; blank = uppercased canonical
#   bg          hex chip background; blank = default surface
#   asset       filename stem under Assets/Marks/Formats/ (<stem>.svg); non-blank -> render that
#               SVG instead of the symbol/label (CE had only two true pictograms - see SOURCES.md)
